items.title: Cisco patches Secure Email Gateway zero-day exploited in attacks
items.summary: Cisco patched CVE-2026-76519 (CVSS 9.8), a path traversal flaw in the Secure Email Gateway's AMP File Reputation path that let unauthenticated attackers write arbitrary files and execute commands with root privileges. Updating Content Scanner Tools to 25.3.0.5525 or later fixes it without a restart.

items.title: SAP patches CVSS 10.0 SSRF in Cloud SDK for Python
items.summary: SAP fixed CVE-2026-89111, a maximum-severity SSRF in the Cloud SDK for Python that let unauthenticated attackers hijack OAuth2 token requests via the tenant_subdomain parameter and steal client credentials from multi-tenant BTP apps. Patch is in version 0.45.2; all prior versions are vulnerable.

items.title: Qilin ransomware group claims attack on Brame Telecom
items.summary: The Qilin ransomware group publicly claimed an attack on Brame Telecom on October 15, with the exposure report indicating two passwords and two cookies were compromised. The victim's Microsoft 365 and Proofpoint Essentials accounts are flagged as at risk of takeover.

items.title: Whistles pauses online orders after parent TFG London hit by cyber attack
items.summary: TFG London, parent of fashion brands Whistles, Hobbs and Phase Eight, confirmed a cybersecurity incident on October 11 affecting IT systems; Whistles paused website ordering while stores stay open. The company says it has no reason to believe payment information is at risk.

items.title: 0patch micropatches critical Windows Server DNS RCE on legacy systems
items.summary: 0patch released micropatches for CVE-2026-62878, a stack-based buffer overflow in Windows DNS Server allowing unauthenticated remote code execution, bringing Microsoft's August recursion-depth fix to unsupported Server 2008 R2, 2012 and 2012 R2 installs with no restart required.

items.title: Critical command injection in Komodo Periphery (CVE-2026-110005)
items.summary: CERT/CC disclosed CVE-2026-110005 in Komodo Periphery, where container names and log queries were passed into sh -c without escaping, letting users with Read/Logs permissions run commands as root. Fixed in 2.3.0; all earlier versions should update immediately.
